description: Call this first, once per session. It explains how Table, Bro works, a Web Components table engine on top of the UI library of your project, and which tool to use when; shows a minimal table for your target and skin; lists the topics of get_docs. Do not call it again in the same session: use get_docs. Example: {"target": "angular", "skin": "mat"}

skin.description: The skin, the UI library the table works on top of: mat (Angular Material), bs (Bootstrap 5) or nv (native HTML, no library)

target.description: The target: angular for an Angular project, through the wrapper <table-bro-ng>; vanilla for a page without a framework, the Custom Element <table-bro> itself

name: get_started
title: Get started with Table, Bro
